notes.text: The first passage calls him Rav Acha bar Rav Uva and gives the teaching he transmits in Rav Asi’s name.
[A later reference on the same folio](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.50b.7) uses Rav Acha bar Uva, as Hyman does.
